items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Dick and Julia are so beautiful, people.

ctx.x: closeness. Dick and Julia are so beautiful, people. But Benny encouraged me. I never got a ray, although I got one mini-ray once. It wasn’t for playing. I stayed out for a day and a half. I had the time off, but the last time he saw me was leaving the Dorchester with Ava Gardner.
And that got you the ray?
